CreateHiTSDBInstance.description_en: Creates a TSDB instance by calling CreateHiTSDBInstance

DeleteHiTSDBInstance.description_en: Deletes a Time Series Database (TSDB) instance

DescribeHiTSDBInstance.description_en: Calls DescribeHiTSDBInstance to retrieve the details of an instance

DescribeHiTSDBInstanceList.description_en: Queries the list of Time Series Database (TSDB) instances
DescribeHiTSDBInstanceList.description_zh: 调用DescribeHiTSDBInstanceList查询数据库获取实例列表

DescribeHiTSDBInstanceSecurityIpList.description_en: Retrieves the IP address whitelist of an instance

DescribeRegions.description_en: Calls DescribeRegions to query the list of regions where Time Series Database can be deployed
DescribeRegions.description_zh: 调用DescribeRegions查询可部署时序数据库的Region列表

DescribeZones.description_en: Calls DescribeZones to obtain the zone information supported by instances
DescribeZones.description_zh: 调用DescribeZones获取实例支持的可用区信息

ModifyHiTSDBInstanceClass.description_en: Modifies the specifications of an instance by calling ModifyHiTSDBInstanceClass

ModifyHiTSDBInstanceSecurityIpList.description_en: Configures the IP address whitelist of an instance

RenameHiTSDBInstanceAlias.description_en: Calls RenameHiTSDBInstanceAlias to modify the alias of an instance

RenewTSDBInstance.description_zh: 调用RenewTSDBInstance为包年包月付费类型实例进行续费操作

RestartHiTSDBInstance.description_en: Restarts a Time Series Database (TSDB) instance

SwitchHiTSDBInstancePublicNet.description_en: Switches the public network connection status of an instance
